_about: arkhipelagos in-game lines, English master. Lines marked source bwap are derived from PokemonBWAP's lines (MIT, see CREDITS.md); the others are ours. Official names are placeholders filled from each cartridge's own text, never translated by hand.

_format.\\c: wait for a button, then clear the box
_format.{c:N}: text colour N (2 key item, 3 place); {c:0} back to normal
_format.{buf:N}: word buffer N, filled by the script (a name, a number, an item)
_format.{item:N}: the cartridge's name of item N (a/0/0/2/54)
_format.{species:N}: the cartridge's name of species N (a/0/0/2/70)
_format.{name:N}: the cartridge's word N of a/0/0/2/0 (Gym Leaders, seasons)
_format.{badge:N}: the cartridge's badge name, entry N of a/0/0/3/64 (11 to 18)
